description: Read several memories/rules/skills in ONE call. Pass any of `memory_ids`, `rule_ids`, `skill_ids` (ids from get_node, list_memories, resolve, or the injected context). Returns `{ memories, rules, skills, missing }` with full bodies + version_id for each. Use this instead of firing pathrule_read_memory/read_rule/read_skill once per id.
name: pathrule_read
title: Read Many
